query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In Massachusetts, the **maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**. A claim can currently pay benefits for **up to 30 weeks**, so the **maximum total weekly payout** is **$33,150** before any dependent allowance, assuming you qualify for the full amount for every week.[2][4]

A couple of important details:
- Your actual weekly benefit is usually about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at the state maximum.[4]
- Massachusetts also allows a **dependency allowance of $25 per dependent** on top of the weekly benefit, up to the applicable limit.[1]
- The total amount you can receive in a benefit year is limited by the rule that benefits can equal **30 times your weekly benefit amount or 36% of your base-period wages**, whichever applies under the program rules.[4]

If you want, I can also calculate your **estimated weekly benefit** and **total possible unemployment amount** based on your past wages.
